entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi Isaac... I hope you can help. I bought a helmet a little while ago, and I need to return it. I'm just so disappointed with it.
I'm sorry to hear that. I can definitely look into the return options for you. To start, could you please provide me with your order number?
Yes, it's VF88602. It's just... the color isn't what I thought it would be. I've been a loyal customer for years, and this is the first time I've ever felt let down.
I understand. Getting the right gear is important. Let me pull up that order. VF88602... okay, I see the aero helmet here. It looks like it was delivered to you 44 days ago. Is that correct?
Oh, has it been that long? I'm so sorry. Things have been a bit tight, and I really needed the money back from this. The box is still unopened, I promise. I never even took it out.
No need to worry at all. Let me just double-check our current return policy for you. One moment.
Okay, thank you. I just feel awful about this.
Alright, I've checked for you. It looks like you're well within our 90-day return window. So, yes, we can absolutely process this return for a full refund.
Really? Oh, thank you so much, Isaac! That's such a huge relief. You have no idea.

Of course, I'm happy to help. We want to make sure you're happy with your purchase, and that includes having the right color for your safety gear. I'm emailing you a prepaid return label now. Just attach it to the package and drop it off at any post office.
I see the email. Thank you again. This really helps me out a lot.
You are very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was everything. You've been wonderful. Have a great day.
You too. Thanks for calling VeloFit, and ride safe.
